name: Jellyfish Girl Apocalypse
source:
Jellyfish Girl Apocalypse is a Ren'Py game about saving the world from flesh-eating jellyfish monster women! Well, that's what it's supposed to be about, but our main character is a bit of a wimp. And a simp. And a weeb. He also has amnesia, so that sucks.

Play as the nameable MC and d̶a̶t̶e̶ defeat the monsters wreaking havoc in Briny city!

[From [url=https://izakaa.itch.io/jellyfish-girl-apocalypse]Itch.io[/url]]
